method: Rendered a fresh 395-page PDF from the unchanged work DOCX, rasterized each target page independently at 120 dpi, fully decoded the page images, and inspected every page at original detail.

excluded_images.reason: Initial pdftocairo PNGs failed full decoding; both were regenerated with pdftoppm before review.
The first viewer result was blank and was not used; page 163 was regenerated with pdftoppm, fully decoded, and reviewed.
A generated contact sheet later failed full decoding. No contact sheet was used for the final judgment; all 40 individual page images were inspected.

checks: orphaned headings, options, explanations, or navigation links
